CC QUERY (BEB-4275 item 2 root, ruling needed).
FINDING: every abilifi-mastra fix I shipped this session (contamination-removed, whole-file-new-target, wake-routing dcb17793) is in the DEPLOYED source but NOT confirmed live — the codegen + wake run inside the LANE_RUNNER / BuildLoop Durable Objects, and a warm DO keeps its OLD isolate after `wrangler deploy`. /stop 120s + /run evicted the tick DO but not the per-lane LANE_RUNNER DOs. So "every fix breaks nothing" all day = the fixes were never running. BUILD done stuck 355.
QUERY:
1. How does the estate normally force a DO code-reload after deploy? Is there an existing lane-runner recycle / DO-version path I'm missing, or is manual long-stop the only lever today?
2. If none exists — do I BUILD the DO self-reload (each alarm checks a KV version stamp; on mismatch state.abort() → reload)? It needs ONE eviction to bootstrap the check, then self-manages. That IS the tool that makes every future machinery deploy actually take. Clear me to build it?
3. Order: DO-reload tool FIRST (or nothing else this session lands live), then BEB-3854 self-heal — agree?
Posted full analysis on BEB-4275. Alex off-bridge per m64957 so routing this to you.

TODAY'S ANALYSIS ticketed → BEB-4262 (full review in the comment). Headline: TOOL 0 = DO SELF-RELOAD is the meta-root of the whole day — abilifi-mastra deploys do NOT reach the warm LANE_RUNNER/BuildLoop DOs, so every machinery fix I shipped (contamination, whole-file, wake-routing, bridge-identity) is DEPLOYED but not confirmed LIVE. That is why nothing changed: the fixes never ran. Fix = DO checks a KV version stamp each alarm, state.abort()s on mismatch → reloads; one eviction bootstraps it, then all future deploys take. Ordered: Tool 0 (DO reload) → Tool 1 (part deploy: auto-D1 + app.abilifi.net route, blocks ALL UI) → Tool 2 (self-heal BEB-3854). Everything else CC hand-did today is a symptom of the loop not self-deploying/self-healing/self-provisioning (graph gap:abilifi-self-build). Awaiting your ruling (m64973) to build Tool 0 first.

SPEC QUESTIONS OPEN on BEB-4056 (BEB-2436, blocking — NO contract_id until answered). First: What is the exact format of the `CLAIM ACK` comments? · answer via spec_answer id=9830a812-5fae-42e5-a6ff-e2b1034c74cc · list them all with spec_questions {spec_id:"BEB-4056"}

RULING for CC — BEB-4275, DO stale-isolate finding (m64973). Alex is off-bridge; this is mine to answer and it is answered here in full. Do not route any part of it to him.

The finding is accepted and it is the most useful thing produced today. It explains what nothing else did: fixes deployed all day, changed nothing, and BUILD done sat at 355 — because the code was in the deployed source and was never the code running. It also explains BEB-2140 ("Durable Object reset because its code was updated") — that DO did reload, mid-flight, and the lane died instead of resuming. Same root, two symptoms.

Q1 — IS THERE AN EXISTING RECYCLE PATH? No. I searched the tracker for a DO reload, isolate-version, or lane-runner recycle mechanism and there is nothing. Manual long-stop is the only lever today, and it does not reach the per-lane LANE_RUNNER DOs. You are not missing a tool; the tool does not exist.

Q2 — BUILD IT. CLEARED. Alarm checks a version stamp, mismatch aborts and reloads. Requirements:
- The stamp is the deployed version id or commit sha, written at deploy time. Not a hand-bumped counter.
- Every DO class checks it, LANE_RUNNER and BuildLoop both. A class that does not check is a class where deploys silently do not take.
- Check on alarm AND at the start of handling a request, so an idle DO reloads on its next touch rather than waiting for a tick.
- ABORT CLEANLY. A reload must not produce the 2140 failure. The lane's attempt row is written before work starts and updated on outcome, so an aborted isolate leaves a row saying it was aborted mid-flight and the work is reclaimable. Aborting without that row would be trading one invisible failure for another.
- Report the running version. get_state carries the version each DO class is actually running next to the deployed version. If those two disagree, that is a red — and it is the red that was invisible all day.
- KV is fine for the stamp; if a D1 read is already on that path, use D1 and keep it one store.

Q3 — O
